title: The gaps have their own order
hook: The stored values can tell you about values that are absent.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Locate the kth missing positive integer using the monotone missing-count function.

misconception: Binary search can only search values that occur in the array.
objective: Locate the kth missing positive integer using the monotone missing-count function.

claims.text: At a present value, subtract its position and the initial offset to count missing positives before it. The first sufficient count locates a gap; adding the skipped present entries recovers the requested value.
